m: Oven to 210°C. Cube the pumpkin, toss with oil, cumin and salt, roast 30 minutes until caramelised.
Mix the harissa with a squeeze of lemon and a little oil, and coat the chicken. Leave 15 minutes.
Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 2 parts water for 12 minutes. Drain and fluff.
Pan-fry or grill the chicken 5 to 6 minutes a side. Rest and slice.
Toss the quinoa with the spinach, pumpkin, thinly sliced red onion, lemon juice and a little oil.
Top with chicken, crumbled fetta and yoghurt mixed with chopped mint.
l: Built for lunch. Good warm or cold, yoghurt on the side.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the harissa label.
